title: Kathleen P Probable NDE 4145
content: I was critically ill, had surgery and within twenty-four hours I was septic and went into adult respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and placed on a ventilator. I remained unconscious for six days and it was unknown if I would survive. I remember waking twice. Once I saw my fingers and being a nurse thought to myself, 'Oh boy I'm septic,' and again to see my nurse holding my Foley catheter, I noticed the color of my urine and again to myself thought, 'Multi-system failure, that's bad.' Next, I found myself surrounded by an all-consuming light. It was wonderful, comforting and described as incredibly good. It was a glow as if in the center of a candle flame, that orange yellow glow. I had no sense of body and saw only the light. I felt torn between staying and so wanted to. I heard myself say, 'But he is only nine,' referring to my son. Immediately after that, I found myself sitting in my hospital bed there were no machines, no IV's, I felt fine. There was a knock at my window. I knew I was on the second floor and was surprised. With a giggle I said, 'Okay I'll play along, come in!' I closed my eyes and when I opened them, I saw my grandfather standing at the foot of my bed shaking his finger at me and shaking his head. I closed my eyes. I was again in my hospital bed unable to speak and my friend was wiping my mouth. I heard her say, 'Oh she's drooling.' After that the process of waking up and recovering began.

environment.environment_other_detail: All-consuming light described as a glow like the orange-yellow center of a candle flame.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Post-surgery sepsis with ARDS; on ventilator; unconscious for six days.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hospital-bed scene with 'no machines, no IVs' and a window knock; later saw grandfather at foot of bed shaking finger/head.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Medical awareness while intermittently waking, then all-consuming light with no body, then an apparent hospital-room scene (no machines) and encounter with grandfather, then return to impaired physical state in hospital bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Apparent return to a version of the hospital bed with no machines/IVs and feeling fine; a knock at a second-floor window followed by seeing her grandfather at the foot of the bed shaking his finger/head.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Oh boy I'm septic,' 'Multi-system failure, that's bad.' 'But he is only nine,' 'Okay I'll play along, come in!' 'Oh she's drooling.'
